notes.title: "Don't Mess with Devil for Popularity!" - Deadly Broadcast's Warning
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40727825/006431a2126c5feab096e48fe1d2d5b2bbaa44c5.jpg[/img]

"Deadly Broadcast" is not your typical video game. In this immersive experience, players step into the shoes of a renowned online streamer, whose quest for fame unwittingly unleashes a long-dormant demon from its dark slumber within a forbidding prison. The challenge is both simple and terrifying: survive the paranormal onslaught while keeping the camera rolling to gain popularity.

This game is a stark reminder of the consequences that lurk behind the relentless pursuit of online stardom. As a player, every decision you make counts, as your choices will ultimately shape the outcome of the story. It's a treacherous path you must navigate.

Within the game, you'll encounter haunting settings and confront otherworldly entities, all while striving to maintain the quality of your live stream. The more spine-chilling the encounters, the greater your viewership and online reputation. "Deadly Broadcast" adds an exciting twist to gaming, where you risk it all for the allure of online celebrity.

The game's unique blend of suspense and supernatural horror has catapulted it into the gaming community's spotlight. It's sparked conversations about the moral dilemmas associated with the relentless pursuit of internet fame. "Don't Mess with Devil for Popularity!" is a chilling mantra, a reminder that some things are best left unexplored, even if it means potentially losing a few virtual followers along the way.

In "Deadly Broadcast," remember: the path to popularity might be fraught with more peril than you can imagine.

notes.title: BIG UPDATE - New Prison Map Puzzles! Get Ready to Challenge Mad Guardian Ghost!
notes.content:
Great news Deadly Broadcast players! We have worked very hard to make our game better. We have completed our Prison Map Puzzles and modified the Game Mechanics. 

Our Streamer characters have figured out that there is only one way to imprison the Mad Guardian Ghost! Now, you have to find the Voodoo dolls crafted by prisoners who wanted to end Guardian's brutality!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40727825/a07c03b83ab0ed408be64e01e55fb679e4b8228b.png[/img]
We have added new puzzles to our Prison map such as Picklocks, Hidden Compartment behind Portraits, Password guarded Cell Doors, Hidden Passages need Right Sequence, Secret pieces in Blood bags.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40727825/ecaec2cec142472f5e8c13b02541cc09163946c4.jpg[/img]
The poor prisoners who have suffered various tortures have created magical voodoo dolls using hair and skin samples they obtained from the crazy prison warden. Our protagonist characters, who accidentally released the ghost of the warden, have only one way to capture and imprison him again! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40727825/5337355338383649957f70859be7cca6ff786365.jpg[/img]

They must break the spells protecting the voodoo dolls by finding salt bags, locate the voodoo dolls and the papers containing the spells, and burn them! This is the only way to break free from the curse they are trapped in. They need to collect the missing cage pieces, assemble the cage, and trap the spirit of the insane prison warden inside the cage again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40727825/31e23212f9eacd0b05e4b89a704a1f025ece6d32.gif[/img]

We have also made lots of improvements on the game basics and mechanics. You can find all the improvements in this update listed below:
[list]
[*] Inventory Slots are increased. You can use keypad numbers from 1-9 to take the equipment in your hand from your inventory.
[*] We have polished the Zombie Dying Animations and Camera shake Animations in order to increase the Hit Feeling.
[*] Fixed Inventory Drag and Drop item Bug, FPS Hand Freezing Bug.
[*] We have upgraded our Photon Network Library. Now, players will have better Co-op experience without Drop out.
[*] We have done good Performance Optimization. Main Menu, Lobby Scene and Game Play Scene is loading faster now.
[*] We have improved and replaced many of the Streamer Characters Voices and Sound Effects.
[*] Your Chat and your Fans' messages are less toxic now :) 
[/list]
[b]Stay tuned! We are working on our new Map. It is coming soon: Houtouwan - Abandoned and Scary Chinese Fisherman Village![/b]

notes.title: Good News: Gamepad Bug is Fixed! 🎮 Mac M1 and M2 devices are Supported now! 🖥
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40727825/196d23fce03c236e6eff543692820ffe4f57cafd.jpg[/img]

Hi everybody! Deadly Broadcast team is working to make the game better for you. We have two big news for you.

[h3]Automatic Controller Switching Bug is Fixed 🎮[/h3]
There are tens of different controllers for the games. Our game had automatic controller switching feature. This means, if any kind of controller is plugged to PC, the game automatically switches the input and player supposes that there is a problem about Keyboard and Mouse.

We have disabled this feature and added a new setting into the Settings Panel (Controller).
Now, the game always starts with Keyboard and Mouse input. If player wants to play with his/her GamePad, he/she can go to Settings Panel and switch to GamePad easily by changing Controller option.

[h3]Mac M1 and M2 Devices are Supported Now 🖥[/h3]
Deadly Broadcast was working on Mac devices with only Intel architecture. Now, our game is started to support both Mac M1 and M2 devices too with the last Mac version update.

notes.title: Big Update Alert! New User Interface + More Challenging Chat Donations!
notes.content:
Hi Deadly Broadcast Streamers!
Full Release is very soon. We have two great news (Actually three but one is special gem for future updates):

[h3]Fully Redesigned User Interface[/h3]
We have designed all User Interface elements with much better visuals. Now, All Buttons, Panels, Options, Texts and Icons are more compatible with the theme and concept of the game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40727825/31fb8047c71bc019c03b415ecf048ca8588d1313.jpg[/img]
Main Menu is now more compatible with the concept of the game. The theme is darker but also so clear to use.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40727825/27b7221be28e74f19e58320f1bcc1c1de2cbe729.jpg[/img]
Streamer Character Selection UI is redesigned also. We can see and examine the characters with rotation function now. Map Selection UI and Details about the characters are easier to read.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40727825/d55c3ea9afc370606866b3daf9c03d5aaa5e750a.jpg[/img]
Fake AI based Chat is clearer now. Players can easily read the messages. Donations background panel is half transparent with more realizable red line. Challenges are left aligned with objective icon.


[h3]New and More Challenging Donation Tasks[/h3]
In previous versions, players were sometimes assigned missions that didn't make sense and didn't match the current state of the game. For example, go shoot a demon in the head as a mission while the player is not holding a gun. Or we used to say don't use medkit for 1 minute when our health is already 100.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40727825/5856020983ddb4e3c9477cf5c3380026d119214a.png[/img]

[b]NOW, we redesigned all donation tasks carefully and added new more logical donation tasks.
Players will enjoy much more now! [/b]

notes.title: We listen you. Important Update is released!
notes.content:
We listen you and value your thoughts! Our team has worked so hard and prepared a much better version! Deadly Broadcast is starting now!

1. Electric Switch Box mechanic is improved. Now you can easily cut electric off by only pressing E button.
2. Better FPS Combat Moves! Now you can defend yourself by pressing Mouse Right button and block Monsters' hit.
3. Inventory Spawn System is updated. Now, lootable objects are spawning in related rooms.
4. Enemy Monsters graphics are improved and added burning particles.
4. Reading Notes and Examining Padlock mechanics are updated! Fonts are visually upgraded.
5. Collider bugs and Low resolution texture problems are fixed.
6. Weapon grab and drop mechanics are improved! Colliders are fixed.
7. Game Over Screen is improved
8. Pentagram pieces and Special Room keys are visually more noticeable now.
9. Monster animations are smoothier now. 
10.FPS freeze and stuck problem is fixed! Our FPS is much better now!
11. All of our 8 characters are selectable now without need of any purchase.
12. Join Room & Door Name UI improvements are done.
